newsitem.title: FRANCE: French AIDS cases cut by more than half.
newsitem.headline: French AIDS cases cut by more than half.

text.p: French health authorities said on Wednesday AIDS cases and deaths dropped by more than half last year.
Statistics released by the Health Ministry said the number of new AIDS cases dropped by 57 percent between the end of 1995 and the end of 1996 compared with the previous year.
It said the number of deaths from AIDS fell by 60 percent.

The ministry last month reported that 2,285 people died of AIDS last year. France is the European nation worst hit by the epidemic, with 50,000 reported cases, 30,000 deaths and 110,000 people who had tested positive for AIDS virus infection.
